pages.text: In your own inventory, $(thing)Shift-click$() a hotbar stack to send it to the backpack. Shift-click a backpack slot to send up to one regular stack to the hotbar. With Mouse Tweaks, hold Shift and drag with the left button across several slots.

pages.title: Open Containers
pages.text: Shift-click a backpack slot to send up to one regular stack to the open container. Any remainder stays in the backpack.$(br2)When you Shift-click from a chest, matching stacks fill first, followed by empty slots in the hotbar and then in the backpack.

pages.title: Other Mods
pages.text: Supported screens replace the usual player storage rows with the storage grid. Some modded screens with custom layouts need their own integration. With JEI installed, click either search field to choose where your typing goes.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Use the 2×2 crafting grid in your inventory or work at a crafting table as usual. The vanilla recipe book can use eligible ingredients from storage, even when they span multiple stacks.
